```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin {component: 'block_semantic_web'})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Plugin)
WHERE dependency.last_release_ts IS NOT NULL AND dependency.last_release_ts < (apoc.date.parse('2026-09-10', 'yyyy-MM-dd').epochMillis / 1000) - (3 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60)
RETURN dependency.component, dependency.name, dependency.last_release_ts
ORDER BY dependency.last_release_ts ASC
LIMIT 100
```
